notes: Village on modified cash basis (governmental) with accrual-style proprietary statements; basis recorded as cash. Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds revenues/expenditures statement (pp7-10, 8 fund columns). Business-type (Electric, Sewer, Water) from the proprietary funds Totals column (p12); receipts total = operating revenues 915,398 + interest 13,046 (computed); roll: 1,531,754 + 928,444 - 889,869 - 23,901 = 1,546,428. Governmental roll: 877,510 + 831,659 - 1,439,593 + 23,901 + 450,000 = 743,477 (Road Fund loan proceeds 450,000). Governmental transfers in 23,901 match business-type net transfers out. Beginning balance 877,510 is the fund balance (= cash on cash basis). Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the governmental fund statement columns (pp7-10) and the proprietary fund columns (p12); they replace the earlier combined expenditure-by-object Total column and the p15 budgetary comparison utility lines, which are no longer in detail (so the former decision question about Electric 'Disbursements and Transfers' 854,534 on p15 no longer applies and was removed). The Schedule of Expenditures by object (pp16-17) is not recorded (open question for the user whether it should replace the governmental expenditure lines). Business-type Other operating revenues 7,181 recorded as other (nature unexplained); statement utility Charges for Services 908,217 is Utility Charges, same as its per-fund detail lines. Balance sheet uses Statement of Net Position Total column (p1). Statement of cash flows p13 not used (cash basis; proprietary field null). Attempt 3 (verifier fixes 2026-10-28): notes ending corrected, stale p15 decision removed, business-type Charges for Services set to Utility Charges. Read pages 1-17 of 17
